scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && node build-matcher.ts
scripts.test:provider: pnpm --filter pi-bring-your-own-sandbox build && pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.provider.config.ts
scripts.test:package: pnpm --filter pi-bring-your-own-sandbox build && pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.package.config.ts
